incidents.vector: social engineering of a custody operator
incidents.summary: A mid-tier exchange reported the unauthorized movement of roughly $187M after an operator was tricked into approving a malicious transaction; analysts link the laundering pattern to DPRK-affiliated activity.
A cross-chain bridge associated with VolgaPay lost about $64M through a contract flaw; on-chain tracing showed funds routed through mixers commonly used by Russia-based operators.
A regional exchange reported ~$23.5M drained via leaked API credentials; attribution to Iran-linked actors is tentative and contested.
